Finai for Publication

Substitute Narrative and Plans
Type 1 Rezoning Attachment

1420 West Division Ave. Chicago, IL 60642

The Project
1420 West Division Ave landowner (the applicant), Ali Manesh is proposing to develop a newly

constructed masonry building containing 6 dwelling units, 2 car parking spaces, and 6 bicycle
and motorcycle spaces in a transit-served location (TSL). The subject property’s frontage is
located less than 1050 feet from CTA Blue Line rail station (Division/Milwaukee) entrance and
therefore is considered to be in a TSL area that makes it eligible for up to 100% reduction of
minimum off-street parking as per 17-10-0102-B ordinance.

To construct the proposed project, the applicant seeks a change of zoning classification for the
subject property from B3-2 to B2-3. This change of zoning classification is being sought through
the Type I rezoning process of Section 17-13-0302-A of the Zoning Ordinance for reduction of
Minimum Lot Area per Dwelling Unit from 1000 sft to 400sft (under section 17-3-0402),
increase of standard for Floor Area Ratio from 2.2 to 3 (under Section 17-3-0403), and 67%
reduction of required Parking (under Section 17-10-0102-B) of the Zoning Ordinance. The
proposed development will build four story building with about 6800 SFT including 6 residential
units.

The Site

The 2400 SFT site (per record, 24 X 100) is a substandard rectangularly shaped parcel on the
North side of West Division Avenue. It is bounded by a4 story mixed used building on east with
a 15 feet rear setback, a two-story frame building and a two-car garage on the east with zero rear
setback, and a 16’ wide public alley on the north. The subject site is presently an empty lot.

The following are the relevant bulk calculations for the proposed development:

(a) Floor Area Ratio: Proposed 2.97, allowed 3, per section 17-3-0402 of the Zoning
Ordinance.

(b) Density (lot area per dwelling unit); Minimum Lot Area per dwelling unit (MLA):
proposed 400 sft/du as allowed 400 sft/du per section 17-3-0402 of the Zoning
Ordinance.

(c) Off-Street Parking / loading; proposed 2 car and 10 bike spaces and requesting 67% relief
under section 17-10-0102-B.

(d) Setbacks: Proposed zero for the front, east, and west, zero required, and proposed 15’ for
the back, 30’ is required.

(e) Building height: proposed 45’-7” feet, allowed 50 feet.
